{{external|dw=Ring of Pursuit}} {{Infobox Item |name = Ring of pursuit |image = [[File:Ring of pursuit.png]] |release = [[2 February]] [[2017]] |update = Silver Jewellery, Tournament World & QoL! |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Check, Break, Drop |wornoptions = Check |examine = This ring can reveal a hunter creature's track. |value = 1050 |weight = 0.006 |exchange = Yes |id = 21126 }} [[File:Ring of pursuit detail.png|left|130px]] A '''ring of pursuit''' is an [[opal ring]] enchanted via the [[Lvl-1 Enchant]] spell. When worn, it will reveal the entire track of [[hunter creatures]] (excluding [[herbiboar]]s) caught via [[noose wand]]. The ring will provide 10 charges before disappearing. The number of charges is specific to the player, not the ring, so swapping, dropping, or casting [[alchemy spells]] on rings before all charges are used will '''not''' reset the number of charges the player has left before a ring breaks. Players can right-click a ring of pursuit to either "check" how many charges remain in it or "break" it and reset the next one they use to its maximum charges. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = 0 |arange = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = ring }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Magic |skill1lvl = 7 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 17.5 |members = Yes |ticks = 1 |ticksnote = Manual casting is 3 ticks, auto-casting is 7 ticks |mat1 = Opal ring |mat2 = Cosmic rune |mat3 = Water rune |output1 = Ring of pursuit }} ==Dialogue== {{hastranscript|scenery}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 8 May 2024 |update = Project Rebalance: Skilling & Poll 81 MTA Changes |change = The ring of pursuit's effect is now guaranteed to activate, up from a 25% chance. }} {{Subject changes |date = 24 April 2024 |update = Varlamore Tweaks, GameJam V Commences & More! |change = The ring of pursuit can now be stored in the [[huntsman's kit]]. }} {{Subject changes |date = 9 March 2023 |update = Even More Poll 78 Changes |change = The inventory icon has been re-centred. }} {{Subject changes |date = 16 February 2017 |update = Party Pete's Birthday Bash |change = The item's inventory sprite was rotated, so that unenchanted silver jewellery now has non-standard angles instead. }} {{Subject changes |date = 9 February 2017 |update = Colourful Golems & Graphical Improvements |change = The "Break" option was added. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Ring of pursuit detail v1.png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Ring of pursuit detail v2.png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Ring of pursuit detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Ring of pursuit v1.png|center]] |[[File:Ring of pursuit v2.png|center]] |[[File:Ring of pursuit.png|center]] |- |2 February 2017 –
